headline: Pakistan's weekly SPI inflation stood at 11.38% year-on-year in the week ending October 15, while the index fell 0.04% week-on-week, Pakistan Bureau of Statistics data showed.

card.desc: Wheat flour up 3.36%, chicken up 3.31% in week to Oct 15

caption:
Short-term inflation measured by the weekly SPI stood at 11.38% year-on-year in the week ending October 15, APP and Dawn reported, citing Pakistan Bureau of Statistics data. Prices fell 0.04% from the previous week as tomatoes dropped 23.05%, while wheat flour rose 3.36% and chicken 3.31%.
